record.question: Which of the following options is incorrect with regards to the responsibility of an Inspector mentioned in the Mizoram Excise & Narcotics Manual, 2005?
options: He is directly responsible to his Controlling officer/Superintendent
He must maintain a clean image and gain respect and confidence of his subordinates
He must encourage his subordinates and guide them, especially junior and inexperienced officers
He should bring petty misconducts of his subordinates to the notice of his superiors
